title: Sprint lab: manager prep & 90-day focus (Anika Bose)
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad to prepare for skip-level and manager check-ins; consolidate 90-day focus, micro-evidence, and key asks. Use this to rehearse anecdotes and pick 3 priority asks.

Highest-priority narrative (30s):
- Focus: move from reactive hiring ops to partnership model — measure via time-to-fill reduction and hiring manager NPS.
- Why it matters: org growth velocity depends on predictable hiring cadence; my work reduces friction (templates, screening SLAs, interviewer training).
- Concrete ask: 1) support to run one cross-functional recruiter training pilot (2 weeks), 2) owner-level alignment session with Eng PMs, 3) bandwidth for one process owner for 6 weeks.

90-day focus (top 3):
1) Launch recruiter training pilot (metrics: interviewer survey score + reduce time to offer by 10% for pilot roles).
2) Build and ship 1 standardized hiring checklist + scorecard template for IC-3 to IC-5 roles (templates + short video).
3) Run backlog clean-up with hiring managers (target: close 20% stale reqs and reprioritize).

Micro-evidence bank (quick anecdotes / data points):
- Anecdote A: Helped EngA fill senior backend role: reduced loop time from 36d -> 22d by introducing pre-screen rubric and 2-step scheduling window. Manager feedback: "felt smoother; better candidate quality" (Slack convo 2026-01-29).
- Metric snapshot: average time-to-offer (team sample) Dec 2025 = 40d; Jan 2026 pilot cohort = 28d (internal sheet link CONFLUENCE-8452).
- Win: interviewer guide pilot (5 PMs): rated 4.3/5; comments requesting more sample questions (action).

Objections I expect & short responses:
- "We don’t have headcount": propose stressing process improvements that don’t require hires first; show quick wins that free up hiring manager time.
- "This seems heavy lift": break into 2-week sprints, start with 1 role family and scale.

Manager prep bullets (for 1:1):
- Quick status (30s): recruiter pilot live; templates ready for review; backlog triage scheduled.
- Ask (60s): approve 2 weeks of recruiter capacity to run pilot + priority list of 6 roles.
- Risk & support I need: access to hiring manager calendar blocks for next 2 weeks; intro to Eng leadership for alignment session; permission to update job scorecards centrally.

Evidence to bring if asked:
- Before/after hire timelines for 4 recent roles (spreadsheet link: CONFLUENCE-8452).
- Excerpts from interviewer survey (anonymized).
- Slack snippets from hiring managers praising faster loop (saved in linked_artifacts).

Prep script for skip-level (90s):
- Open: "Quick update — running a 2-week recruiter training pilot to tighten our screen-to-offer loop; early signals show ~20-30% improvement for pilot roles."
- Why: "This reduces waste and candidate drop-off, helps us hire faster without more headcount."
- Ask: "Would love your help to unblock 2 calendar alignment sessions and identify 2 priority roles we should focus on."

Today’s TODO (priority order):
- [ ] Finalize scorecard template and send to Jonah for review (due 2026-03-12).
- [ ] Draft invite for alignment session and owners list (send by EOD).
- [ ] Pull updated time-to-offer numbers and anonymize for skip-level.
- [ ] Short rehearsal of skip-level script with Evelyn (15 min).

Open questions / to research:
- Which hiring managers historically resist centralized scorecards? (Ask Jonah for historical list).
- Are there existing training modules in Lattice we can reuse? (Confluence search).
- How much recruiter capacity can be flexed without impacting high-priority reqs? (talk to recruitment lead).

Notes-to-self (looser):
- Keep anecdotes < 2 mins. Pick 1 strong metric + 1 emotional anecdote.
- If pressed on ROI, show % reduction and estimate projected hires saved per quarter.
- Save copy of all messages in a folder for later performance write-up.

End-of-day reflection prompts (to fill post-1:1):
- What part of the ask landed? (manager reaction)
- Did I lose them on resourcing or impact? (capture verbatim)
- One improvement for next time.

References & quick links:
- Confluence playbook: CONFLUENCE-8452 (pilot data + templates).
- Jira: HR-312 (recruiter pilot ticket).
- Slack thread: #people-ops-weekly (pilot updates).
